subject: DATE-OF-INTEGER function
notes: Integer date N maps to the day N days after 1600-12-31 (§15.5.2 starting date + §15.5.1 calendar/leap Note): the golden pins §15.5.2's two stated endpoints (1 -> 16010101, 3067671 -> 99991231) plus all three leap branches (1155 -> 16040229, 145791 -> 20000229, 36218/36219 -> 17000228/17000301 consecutive) and 143951 -> 19950215.
